description: Do I need a visa? Visa requirement for one passport (nationality) traveling to one destination country — returns visa-free (with allowed stay days when known), visa on arrival, e-visa, eTA, visa required, or no admission. Covers 199×199 country pairs. Data: community-maintained Passport Index snapshot (last updated 2026-02-18) — verify with official sources before travel. Example: visa_requirement({ passport: "United States", destination: "Brazil" })

destination.description: Destination country — ISO2, ISO3, or country name, e.g. "BR", "Japan", "Türkiye"

passport.description: Passport / nationality — ISO2, ISO3, or country name, e.g. "US", "DEU", "South Korea", "UK"

name: visa_requirement
title: Visa Requirement
